name: 2D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)
definition: A standard 2D CNN architecture used for image classification, implemented here as an example model function for TensorFlow Estimators. It consists of two convolutional layers, two max-pooling layers, a dense layer, and a softmax output.
summary: A 2D Convolutional Neural Network extracts spatial features from 2D input grids through hierarchical convolution and pooling, distinguishing itself with a feed-forward structure ending in a fully connected classifier.
